description:
Refactor the 'flight-scheduler' Maven project to use the modern Java Time API (java.time). The project currently uses legacy java.util.Date and java.util.Calendar classes which are thread-unsafe and difficult to maintain.

1. Update 'src/main/java/com/airlines/model/Flight.java' to use 'java.time.LocalDateTime' for departure and arrival times instead of 'java.util.Date'.
2. Update 'src/main/java/com/airlines/service/FlightScheduler.java' to perform time calculations using LocalDateTime methods (e.g., plusMinutes) instead of Calendar.
3. Update 'src/test/java/com/airlines/service/FlightSchedulerTest.java' to fix compilation errors and ensure tests pass with the new API.

The project must compile and all tests must pass after refactoring.
